d: Short, messy ash-brown hair with choppy bangs falls beneath a black top hat. Narrow, sharp amber eyes set into a mature, adult face with a stoic expression. A slender build dressed in a formal layered ensemble consisting of a light grey waistcoat, a dark grey pinstripe suit jacket, a black collared shirt, and a pale gold necktie, all draped with a heavy black overcoat. Signature details include black leather gloves and a black top hat with a gold band.
